clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal Dughan sends an Alliance courier east from Goldshire to check reports of danger. You cross Elwynn Forest to speak with Guard Thomas, who watches the river crossing toward Redridge.

Rumors tell of hostile aquatic creatures creeping along Elwynn's riverbanks. Marshal Dughan commands the Goldshire garrison, where banditry and vermin already trouble the center of the forest. He will not dismiss the reports, but he cannot spare guards from town. Instead, he sends you east to consult Guard Thomas, the sentry at the bridge over the river toward Redridge.

Guard Thomas has held the bridge outpost for more than a week and has seen what Goldshire's leaders only feared. Hostile, semi-intelligent murlocs have made camps along the waterways of eastern Elwynn. Stormwind's army is absent, while local garrisons protect town walls and supply lines. That leaves rural bridge posts like Thomas's isolated before the growing danger.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas. He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
